cases.description: Calling getSchema(null) should throw a NullPointerException because the method delegates to getSchema(InputStream, null) which expects a non‑null stream.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IllegalArgumentException) indicating that the schema content is empty
cases.description: An empty InputStream does not contain any JSON/YAML. The factory should detect the lack of content and raise an exception rather than returning a valid JsonSchema.
When the stream contains malformed JSON, the internal ObjectMapper/YAMLMapper parsing fails and the method should propagate a parsing exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) with default validation configuration
cases.description: A well‑formed JSON schema should be parsed successfully and a JsonSchema object returned. No custom config is supplied, so default validators are used.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) whose validation context reflects the custom config (e.g., failFast = true)
cases.description: When a non‑null SchemaValidatorsConfig is supplied, the factory must use it to build the ValidationContext. The returned JsonSchema should honour the custom settings.

input.value:
new ByteArrayInputStream("type: object
properties:
  name:
    type: string".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))

cases.description: The factory should detect that the content is YAML (or rely on YAMLMapper) and successfully create a JsonSchema object.

input.value: new InputStream() { @Override public int read() throws IOException { throw new IOException("forced I/O error"); } }

cases.description: If the underlying InputStream throws an IOException while being read, the method must propagate the exception (typically wrapped) rather than silently succeed.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) and the InputStream is closed after method returns
cases.description: The factory should close the provided InputStream after reading the schema. The test verifies that calling schemaStream.read() after getSchema returns -1 (closed).

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) – the UTF‑8 BOM is ignored and the schema is parsed successfully
cases.description: InputStream begins with a UTF‑8 Byte Order Mark before a minimal valid JSON schema. The factory should strip the BOM and return a proper JsonSchema object.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) – whitespace surrounding the JSON does not affect parsing
cases.description: The stream contains only whitespace before and after a valid JSON schema. The parser must ignore surrounding whitespace and produce a JsonSchema.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) – Unicode characters are correctly decoded and stored
cases.description: A schema containing non‑ASCII characters (Cyrillic) is provided. The factory must read the stream using UTF‑8 and create a JsonSchema without errors.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (caused by JsonProcessingException) – comments are not allowed by default Jackson configuration
cases.description: The input JSON contains a block comment. Since the default ObjectMapper used by JsonSchemaFactory does not enable ALLOW_COMMENTS, parsing should fail and the method should wrap the JsonProcessingException.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IllegalArgumentException) indicating that the schema content is empty or whitespace only
cases.description: An InputStream that contains only whitespace characters should be treated as having no usable schema content and result in a clear exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException wrapping IOException and the stream is closed (isClosed() == true)
cases.description: When parsing fails due to an IOException, the factory must still close the provided InputStream. The custom stream tracks closure to verify this behavior.
